title: Sheep holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M72 42 Q68 55 64 64' stroke='#ffd54a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='30' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#ff4a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='30' rx='11' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ff7a92' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='24' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff9aaa' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='72,43 76,43 74,46' fill='#e0395a'/>
  
  <!-- Sheep legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  
  <!-- Sheep body (fluffy wool) -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='66' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#e8e4f0'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='62' r='8' fill='#f0ecf8'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='9' fill='#f0ecf8'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='53' r='9' fill='#f0ecf8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='55' r='9' fill='#f0ecf8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='62' r='8' fill='#f0ecf8'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='72' r='7' fill='#d8d4e4'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='75' r='7' fill='#d8d4e4'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='74' r='7' fill='#e0dce8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='70' r='6' fill='#e0dce8'/>
  
  <!-- Sheep head -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='48' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <!-- Wool tuft on head -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='5' fill='#f0ecf8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='37' r='5' fill='#f0ecf8'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='39' r='4' fill='#f0ecf8'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='17' cy='44' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#4a4a8a' transform='rotate(-20 17 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='44' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#4a4a8a' transform='rotate(20 39 44)'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='47' r='1' fill='#2a2a5a'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='47' r='1' fill='#2a2a5a'/>
  <!-- Nose / mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='53' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#3a3a7a'/>
  <path d='M26 55 Q28 57 30 55' stroke='#7a7aba' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Sheep arm holding string -->
  <path d='M58 62 Q64 58 68 56' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Hoof -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='56' r='3.5' fill='#3a3a7a'/>
</svg>
